platform.isolation: QEMU user networking with restrict=on (no host or internet access); SSH and LuCI forwards to localhost only

start_state: Copy of the development test disk with all LaneKeep dependencies installed and listed in /etc/apk/world. Before the test, the previous LaneKeep files and two old runtime state directories (/etc/lanekeep-state, /etc/lanekeep-health) were removed, three static DHCP hosts were added, and the VM was rebooted; no LaneKeep file remained.

browser.browser: Claude desktop built-in browser against the VM LuCI on localhost
browser.cache: same tab and cache, no forced reload
browser.note: The pane was hidden, so requestAnimationFrame did not fire and LuCI held its queued RPC calls; after each navigation the check replaced requestAnimationFrame with a short timer in the page. Status and Details show the read-error bar on a disabled instance because sampling is not running (unchanged code). Values were recorded by hand from the browser tool results.

target_checks.where: same VM disk after the lifecycle, against the release source tree

logs: Package manager logs with the repeated offline-cache warnings removed
not_covered: explicit activation, kill-switch gate and transparent client traffic and DNS
real nodes, subscriptions and node test through the panel RPC
known_issue: Uninstall leaves a dangling /etc/rc.d/K9lanekeep link; the v0.1.0 acceptance disk shows the same link, and packaging scripts are unchanged.
